note: Funnel mix for blog posts. The orchestrator and keyword researcher pick the stage that is furthest below target in each silo. Change the target here to shift the mix.

tofu.reader: Product/design people learning about a problem the hub service solves
examples: what is a ux audit checklist
user interview questions for saas onboarding

mofu.reader: Teams comparing approaches or planning the work
examples: ux research process for b2b saas
how to choose a ux design agency

firstPostsPerSilo: Start a new silo with 1 BOFU and 1 MOFU post (fastest leads on a young site), then fill toward the target mix.
